name: LoRA adapter train/save/merge lifecycle
definition: Fine-tune a LoRA adapter to a holdout accuracy or the target, persist a reloadable adapter (weights/config/tokenizer), and merge it into the base model.
failure_mode: a missed or wrongly applied merge degrades hidden-set accuracy

name: maintain gradient flow through the full composed model
definition: keep every stage connected so that a backward pass populates parameter gradients.
failure_mode: a detached intermediate stops gradient flow

name: match a reference behavior under a numeric tolerance
definition: reproduce an onnx reference output on both fixed and random inputs within a set error bound
failure_mode: excess numeric drift or reorder fails the closeness assertion

name: meet a threshold accuracy on a held-out test set
definition: The fitted model must classify a separate test dataset with at least a stated accuracy.
failure_mode: Underfit or miscalibrated model falls below the threshold.
